payload.summary: On Call keeps deciding labels, glyphs, destinations and counts from entry.section, so every view over a section is misrendered -- move the view concept into src/lib
payload.detail: The Compliance page is a VIEW over the stored logistics section discriminated by details.kind, not a seventh section: section is a database CHECK constraint and merging a migration reaches the live clinical database within seconds. Any code that reads entry.section to choose a label, icon, destination or count therefore answers Admin for a compliance row. A 2026-09-20 sweep found and fixed seven such sites, then found seven more; all fourteen are fixed, but the cause is not, and this bug class will keep recurring as the mode grows. Two structural reasons, and both are the point of this row. (a) The type system endorses it: ON_CALL_SECTION_HREFS[entry.section] compiles and is wrong, and there is no lint rule against it. (b) The correct helper onCallViewForEntry lives in src/components/on-call/on-call-section-identity.ts, and tests/lib-layering.test.ts forbids src/lib from importing src/components -- so src/lib/on-call/freshness-summary.ts, src/lib/on-call/entry-search.ts and src/lib/on-call/entry-chips.ts are section-keyed because they CANNOT call it, not because anyone chose that. NEXT ACTION, in order of leverage: (1) move the view concept (OnCallPageView, ON_CALL_VIEW_TITLES/ICONS/HREFS, onCallViewForEntry, onCallViewStorageSection) out of src/components/on-call/on-call-section-identity.ts into a new src/lib/on-call/view.ts, which dissolves the layering block that created half the defects; (2) derive a non-stored view field on the entry at the one read boundary, rowToOnCallEntry in src/lib/on-call/repository.ts, so consumers read entry.view and the fix costs no migration and no database change; (3) stop exporting the section-keyed maps (ON_CALL_SECTION_TITLES, ON_CALL_SECTION_ICONS, ON_CALL_SECTION_TILE_DESCRIPTIONS, ON_CALL_SECTION_HREFS) so the wrong answer stops compiling. Deferred on 2026-09-20 because it changes every consumer in the mode and the fourteen live symptoms were already fixed. Unblocks the summariseOnCallFreshness row. Scope check before starting: grep entry.section and .section] across src/lib/on-call and src/components/on-call.
payload.source: Session 2026-09-20, On Call Compliance page clinical-governance review
